constraints: 1 <= M <= 1000 cases; 1 < N < 26; the parcel string holds only capital letters before '#', up to 10000 of them (the official CPE data exceeds 1000), possibly none.
Letters beyond the N-th worker are ignored; a pigeonhole farther from (N+1)/2 must hold at least as many parcels; print the lexicographically smallest worker sequence.
independentMethod: Place pigeonholes left to right, trying letters alphabetically and keeping a choice only if a distance-sorted completion satisfies the pairwise farther-means-heavier dominance check; unit tests compare against exhaustive permutation search for N <= 7.

mutations.label: Always puts the heavier tier count on the left
Sorts counts ascending, putting light mail outside
